value.rationale: The result resolves a natural equality case in the variable-length maximum/average-length problem at the first ternary length-five frontier. It is a complete exact finite cutoff tied directly to the general theory, not an arbitrary sample or a known-table recomputation.
residual_risks: An unindexed exhaustive variable-length census could contain the same mixed-length value, but no such source was located.

final_claim: For ternary variable-length non-overlapping codes with allowed lengths two through five, the maximum size is 17, but the maximum drops to 16 if any codeword has length below five; hence every 17-word extremizer is fixed length five and the minimum average length at cardinality 17 is exactly five.
limitations: Specific to q=3 and maximum length five.
